risks.name: KU baseline and access unconfirmed
risks.why: No verified process, owner or approved sample yet. This can block the operational comparison.
risks.mit: Arrange two interviews and a permitted sample. Record the current workflow.
risks.trigger: No verified baseline by the agreed evidence cut-off.
risks.cont: Use labelled synthetic cases and state that KU benefit remains unverified. Seek instructor direction.

risks.name: AI recommends unsuitable items
risks.why: Eligibility filters and ranking have not been tested.
risks.mit: Filter eligibility before ranking. Freeze labels, check outputs and require staff review.
risks.trigger: Any ineligible actionable result or failure of the matching targets.
risks.cont: Use classic search for task completion, investigate and retest AI. Keep the unmet requirement visible.

risks.name: Restricted data or credentials exposed
risks.why: Data routes and permissions are untested. Confidential disclosure is a severe consequence.
risks.mit: Synthetic data first, minimal fields, permission tests and protected secrets.
risks.trigger: Any unauthorised access, restricted prompt or exposed key.
risks.cont: Stop the affected route, revoke keys and preserve relevant logs. Involve the authorised owner where applicable.

risks.name: Duplicate work removes the benefit
risks.why: KU record-entry obligations and staff acceptance are unknown.
risks.mit: Measure the whole request, including review, handover and reconciliation.
risks.trigger: No lower total handling effort or staff reject the workflow.
risks.cont: Redesign around the verified process or reconsider an existing product. Retain required approvals.

risks.name: Hosting or AI limits interrupt work
risks.why: Real usage, file persistence and recovery have not been tested.
risks.mit: Agree a spending cap. Measure usage and test storage, backup and fallback.
risks.trigger: Failed availability check or projected spend exceeds the approved cap.
risks.cont: Recover or move to a tested option. A temporary local demo does not complete hosted deployment.

risks.name: Work exceeds available time
risks.why: Available hours and task estimates remain unconfirmed.
risks.mit: Estimate dependencies with each owner. Integrate early and review weekly.
risks.trigger: Remaining effort exceeds confirmed capacity or a dependent task slips.
risks.cont: Reassign work and seek instructor agreement for any required-scope change. Record deadline risk.
